---
title: inif.schema
description: JSON Schema export and validation for INIF documents.
reference: inif.schema
---

Helpers that derive the JSON Schema from the Pydantic models and validate
arbitrary dicts against it. The schema documents conventional Token extras
(`logprob`, `logit_lens`) under `$defs.TokenExtras` for downstream
validators.
